feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 May 2026 4:18pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 17 May 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the west of Scotland as various troughs approach from the west of Ireland.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing West or Southwest 3 or 4 at first tonight, then backing South later tomorrow morning and afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon falling slight tonight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers or longer spells of rain, then becoming fair later tonight or at first tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Backing and increasing Southeast 4 or 5 tomorrow evening, then gradually increasing 5 or 6 occasionally 7 overnight into Tuesday. Soon veering South or Southwest 5 or 6 on Tuesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate, possibly rough in a few places for a time.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the southwest, clearing to scattered showers on Tuesday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor at times in the rain.
